notes: I found no Illumina or NovaSeq price records. The Painel de Preços front page (paineldeprecos.planejamento.gov.br) returned HTTP 403 to my fetch, so it looks bot-blocked, and I could not check whether it needs a login. A web search for NovaSeq, flow cell and Illumina procurement with site:gov.br returned no gov.br pages. The Compras.gov.br open-data API is public and its OpenAPI spec loads at https://dadosabertos.compras.gov.br/v3/api-docs. Its price-research module (/modulo-pesquisa-preco/) has two material endpoints, 1_consultarMaterial (with a CSV version) and 2_consultarMaterialDetalhe. Both need a catalog item code (codigoItemCatalogo or codigoPdm), not free text. The endpoints take date filters (dataCompraInicio/dataCompraFim) and a buyer-unit filter (codigoUasg), and return up to 500 rows per page. My one test call used a wrong parameter set and got a 404, so I have not seen real data. I did not find the catalog codes for NovaSeq flow cells or reagent kits. Illumina flow cells are probably filed under generic lab-reagent codes or bought through distributors by exemption or inexigibilidade, so the realized prices may not be tagged as NovaSeq at all. I have no table, no year-over-year change and no AVITI, MGI or Ultima flags. I stopped after 5 tool calls.
how_to_mine: 1) Find the catalog codes first. Search catalogo.compras.gov.br (CATMAT) for 'flow cell', 'NovaSeq', 'sequenciamento', 'kit reagente sequenciador' and 'Illumina', and note each codigoItemCatalogo and codigoPdm. 2) Call https://dadosabertos.compras.gov.br/modulo-pesquisa-preco/1.1_consultarMaterial_CSV?tipo=codigoItemCatalogo&codigo=<code>&dataCompraInicio=2022-01-01&dataCompraFim=2026-10-12&tamanhoPagina=500. Check that the host allows direct requests, since WebFetch needs a dotted hostname and curl or Python may work better. 3) Filter the returned item descriptions for NovaSeq, S4, 10B, 25B, AVITI, MGI, DNBSEQ and Ultima, then group by SKU and year and compute the change in unit price. 4) Cross-check with the PNCP (pncp.gov.br) search and fiscal-contract text for Fiocruz, USP, Unicamp, UFRJ and Butantan purchases. Use a Python script with the -I flag. Do not use Apify.
new_candidates: Compras.gov.br open-data API (dadosabertos.compras.gov.br, modulo-pesquisa-preco), once the catalog codes are known
PNCP, the Portal Nacional de Contratações Públicas, full-text search for 'NovaSeq' contracts and awards
Fiocruz and USP sequencing-reagent tender documents
